sizing_under_v036.what_is_assumed: A SIZING, not a claim anybody stamped. prior_day_rows.clustering: BY DATE: 61 of 85 days carry a prior-day row (1 to 179 rows a day; the top 8 days hold 28.072% of the rows); from 2026-08-13 on 39 of 41 days carry them, before it 22 of 44, so they are steady in the later weeks and scattered before, with 2026-07-02 as the one spike. BY SECURITY: 140 of 356 securities with data carry one; 34 securities with 10 or more rows and a 20% or higher prior-day rate hold 1252 rows (60.806%), so a part of it is persistent per security, while the large funds hold about the same number each (FLCOX 66, MFEIX 66, FSMAX 65). BY FAMILY: fund-shaped tickers 0.843% of their rows, other tickers 1.484%. BY LANDING TIME: days whose last object landed in the 11 UTC hour (37 days) carry them on 35 days, holding 1498 of the 2059 rows; days landing in the 19 UTC hour (21 days) carry them on 6. So the days DO cluster by date (from mid-August), partly by security, and with landing time; this read does not trace why.
